content.title: About
content.content: Baby Toddler Pears are soft, ripe pears prepared especially for children from 12 months old. Stage 2 means small, skin‑less pieces that are easy for toddlers to handle on their own. Pears are rich in vitamins, minerals and dietary fiber, supporting taste development and healthy digestion.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Pears belong to the rose family, along with apples and plums.
In Stage 2 the product is already skin‑less to reduce choking risk for little ones.
Pears contain over 10% water, making them naturally juicy and easy to swallow.
Vitamin C content in pears is higher than in most apples.
Their soft texture makes pears a common first fruit for babies.

items.title: Rich in vitamin C
items.content: Vitamin C supports the immune system and helps iron absorption.

items.title: Source of dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber promotes regular digestion and helps prevent constipation.

items.title: Contains potassium
items.content: Potassium aids fluid balance and supports heart function.

items.title: Low in sugar
items.content: Pears provide natural sugars in moderate amounts, suitable for a toddler’s diet.

items.title: Antioxidants
items.content: Flavonoids in pears help protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Fruit allergy
items.content: Some children may develop an allergic reaction to pears; monitor the first servings.

items.title: Choking hazard
items.content: Even without skin, pieces should be small and soft enough for safe swallowing.

items.title: Fruit acid content
items.content: Kids with sensitive stomachs may experience mild irritation; limit amount if needed.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Baby Toddler Pears, Stage 2 are ready to eat straight from the package. They can be mixed into baby puree, yogurt or oatmeal, or offered as a standalone snack. If desired, warm slightly to room temperature.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the unopened package in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep in the refrigerator in a sealed container and use within 5 days. Discard if any off‑odor or discoloration appears.
